description: manni docs meta/set-up/external-metadata, run in a repo that holds the page's worked examples under test/fixtures/.

steps.description: A bare run reports the bad manifest value at its manifest line.
The owned-key finding names the manifest and its collection, and the summary counts three failures.

runShell.stdio: /is owned by manifest docs-meta.yaml \(collection pages\)[\s\S]*4 files checked, 1 passed, 3 failed, 3 errors/

steps.description: The run sees the manifest's key on the page.
A manifest entry naming a page the run did not load is exit 2.

runShell.stdio: names "docs/gone.md", which this run did not load

steps.description: Two pages sharing one id is a finding on both.
An entry whose id no page carries is exit 2.

runShell.stdio: names id "gone-guide", which no loaded document carries

steps.description: Changing a field-joined page's id is refused.

runShell.command: manni meta query -c test/fixtures/external-metadata-join/manni.config.yaml "UPDATE docs SET id = 'other' WHERE _path = 'docs/auth.md'"
runShell.stdio: is the field manifest docs-meta.yaml joins on

steps.description: A write to a manifest-owned key lands in the manifest, named in brackets.

runShell.command: manni meta query -c test/fixtures/external-metadata/manni.config.yaml "UPDATE docs SET jira = 'PLAT-1' WHERE _path = 'docs/auth.md'" --dry-run
